formalEvidence.scope: Synthetic rule-boundary tests against the frozen public contract. No complete ordinary route, private author witness, browser execution, rendering performance, or physical-device testing is claimed.

numericalComparison.comparison: All gear, budget and hold calculations are exact integers. BigInt signed division determines band/range bounds; outputs return safe integers. Elapsed seconds are compared to mechanical tick/60. No epsilon widens a circular or terminal boundary.

independentReview.method: Mesh-chain tooth counts independently determine signed gear velocities. Actual control transactions partition absolute phase algebra from the original neutral assembly. Each affine pointer span yields exact integer full-interval start ranges in translated circular bands; intersections across all pointers and the appointment produce the one continuous global hold. Budget and action receipts are audited separately from physical tick advancement, including the final zero-interval transaction. No production predicate, controller, witness or observed phase reset is used.
limitations: Only the first existing ordinary six-case public projection is audited. No Model/pilot import, private design witness, gameplay, search, synthetic predicate fixture or new route is used.

Actual held inputs, raw/effective button fields, fresh conflicts, quarantine/arming, selection deltas and actual repeat-age advancement are linked. Navigation repeat firing itself is not independently replayed.
These ordinary inputs do not claim coverage of browser short-pulse aliases, cancellation, host pause/retry, invalid dt or extra terminal/zero-dt calls. Coverage fields list only observed boundaries.

Transactions are complete and receipt-prefix restoration is lossless. Physical intervals are separately continuous; a zero-interval budget loss does not invent motion or reset historical hold. Sparse browser/video observations are outside this audit.
Artwork offsets are checked as public metadata and never treated as physical pointer phase; renderer tooth geometry and GPU output are outside this mathematical review.

liveCaptureWindows.scope: Real continuous window, not a single-state image alias. Actual motor/gear phases, appointment and global hold may advance or terminate during capture. Clutch phase continuity is proved by permanent command receipts; the image is not an exact command instant. Mechanical time uses model.tick, independently of the host tick and transactionCount.

candidateNormalPlay.scope: Only actual public observations and permanent action receipts. Sparse browser trace is not a complete 60 Hz interval stream. Model mechanical ticks, transaction IDs and host ticks are separate; a budget-ending transaction can have no interval. Command before/after phases are separate from subsequent motion. Menu prime never advances the model, and captures never pause or force game state.
candidateNormalPlay.rootScope: Twelve actual full browser images personally reviewed at original dimensions, including four neutral live gameplay observations. Browser checks only; no physical phone or TV test.
candidateNormalPlay.qaScope: All twelve original candidate PNGs personally opened. Four active pictures retain real before/after windows, not exact endpoint image identity. Eight menu/pause/terminal images are stable. Blueprint text and controls were visually reviewed at both viewports; the raw report remains unchanged with visual flags false. This report does not itself freeze or publish any source.

gameRules.scope: Bind actual transaction-indexed frames, phase-preserving clutch receipts, adjustment accounting and source reports. Complete gear displacement, circular interval bands and common hold ranges were audited by the existing independent oracle. This release check runs no Model, pilot, route or reconstruction of missing mechanical intervals.

checks.name: P freezes gameplay state and tick, P resumes
R restarts with clean simulation state
resizing keeps canvas and complete sidebar text visible
no page, console or resource errors
three menus expose every mesh chain, target, tolerance, appointment and hold without hiding controls
held START starts once; phone A and native Enter each switch one clutch without an instantaneous phase jump
held B atomically brakes all trains once; a fresh already-braked B costs nothing
cancel and partial neutral suppress stale commands while real motor and engaged gears continue
disconnect freezes every model field; explicit resume suppresses stale navigation and continues mechanical time
P freezes actual nonzero partly-braked phases and the complete small blueprint/sidebar; resume follows actual mechanical ticks
ordinary public L2 policy spends the last adjustment and naturally terminates without a mechanical interval
R restores the same scenario and budget, with zero action history and naturally advancing initial phases
separate QR room-info layout fixture fits complete text at both TV sizes

rule.text: 容差 ±3° · 预约 32–38 秒 · 共同保持 2 秒

physics.phaseRepresentation: signed integer unwrapped angular displacement; normalized display angle in [0,43200)
physics.integration: one exact constant-velocity closed interval [t,t+1] per running tick

mechanics.clutchKind: ideal phase-preserving friction clutch with brake on the whole downstream train
mechanics.clutchBoundary: motor shaft to the independent train driver shaft; this is a coaxial coupling, not a toothed mesh
mechanics.engagedRule: driver velocity equals +30; each external mesh reverses sign and multiplies angular velocity by parentTeeth/childTeeth
mechanics.releasedRule: all gears in that train have exactly zero velocity; other trains and the motor retain their velocities
mechanics.switchRule: all unwrapped gear phases and pointer mounting offsets remain exactly unchanged at command time; only subsequent velocities change
mechanics.inertia: none; the ideal clutch and brake impose velocity instantly without a position jump
mechanics.meshDisplacementInvariant: for each edge i--j, teeth_i*unwrapped_i + teeth_j*unwrapped_j = 0, relative to the authored neutral assembly
mechanics.idlerRule: an intermediate gear is a real external mesh at both edges; it changes downstream direction parity, its teeth set its own speed, and its teeth cancel out of the final driver-to-output speed ratio
mechanics.pointerRule: only gears with targetUnits are monitored; all pointer marks and tolerances are visible from the instruction/blueprint screen onward
mechanics.geometryRule: render only declared mesh edges; each chain lies left-to-right on one horizontal centerline with common pitch-radius-per-tooth and tangent pitch circles; do not depict a rigid mesh from motor bus to a braked train
mechanics.toothArtworkConvention: a gear's tooth crest is at screen-up when displacement plus fixed toothArtworkOffsetUnits is zero; repeat exactly teeth crests per turn. Tooth artwork offsets do not affect physical displacement or the pointer mounting offset.

performance.note: Intervals between observer RAF callbacks on this browser; not render CPU time or device FPS. WebGL multi_draw counts API submissions, not its subdraws. Canvas paint commands are not GPU draw calls. OffscreenCanvas workers are not observed.

actualGameplay.scope: Actual key edges, phase-preserving clutch receipts and sparse gear/appointment/global-hold endpoints. Transactions are deduplicated by transactionId and physical intervals independently by intervalId; outer host ticks remain separate. Only saved intervals receive local mechanical checks, and hold-window references point only to those intervals. Permanent command receipts bind the real stopped phases and budget. Sampling gaps and unobserved last-action updates remain explicit; no missing gear trajectory, input, or continuous hold interval is reconstructed. The complete first ordinary corpus supplies the separate full-interval audit. No private schedule, replay, or new game execution occurs.

encodedObservationAnchors.scope: Nine unmodified encoded images from actual periodic observations: three stable menu samples, two observed running configurations separated by at least two mechanical seconds with actual motor/gear advancement, partial braking, all-braked alignment before the appointment, the actual global hold and observed win after at least two seconds of terminal hold. Host tick, mechanical tick and transaction count remain distinct. Short clutch or hold states are not asserted unless actually observed; no post-dispatch edge selection, predicted win time, extra Model run or recapture. Original reception order and complete stable encoding-order mapping remain bound. Every image semantic awaits personal review.

hardware.note: Software Chromium with ordinary input. Synthetic fixtures are labelled separately; export FPS is not device FPS.
